name: Ruler of the Black Flame Deck Build Box

releases.name: Ruler of the Black Flame Deck Build Box

description.text: Deck Build Box Ruler of the Black Flame, released on 28 July 2023 with the Ruler of the Black Flame expansion: ten packs of it and 170 cards for building decks, 66 cards of 38 kinds that had done well in official tournaments, such as Radiant Greninja, Lumineon V and Iono, and 13 of each of the eight basic Energy. Some are Sword & Shield cards reprinted. A card box with four dividers and a VSTAR marker came with it. This set holds the 38 kinds.
